retrievalProfile.description: A central ballerina figure in a yellow tutu with a stroboscopic 'multiple arm' effect against a dark, sparkling background with top-aligned serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central ballerina in a golden-yellow tutu stands on a bed of glowing, multi-colored bokeh lights. Her upper body features a stroboscopic effect, creating a fan of translucent arms that suggest rapid movement. The background is a deep, textured dark space with diagonal light streaks, and the typography is placed at the very top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry of the central dancer against the horizontal spread of the arms
Contrast between the bright yellow tutu and the dark, moody background
Relationship between the sharp dancer and the soft, glowing bokeh at her feet
Alignment of text to the top corners, framing the dancer's head

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The ballerina is centered vertically and horizontally, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow tutu serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright tutu, moves up to the face and the fan of arms, then down to the glowing lights at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark negative space surrounds the dancer, emphasizing the light effects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark brown background providing high contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright golden-yellow for the dancer's costume.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Multi-colored (red, green, yellow) bokeh lights at the bottom.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value and saturation on the subject against very low value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in two different sizes or weights for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the elegant, flared serif look with high legibility.
Provides the classical, cinematic all-caps feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a central ballerina in a yellow tutu on a dark stage. Apply a stroboscopic effect to her arms so they appear as a translucent fan. Add a cluster of glowing, multi-colored bokeh lights at her feet and diagonal light streaks in the dark background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place all-caps serif text in white at the top left and top right corners, ensuring the text is clean and sharp against the dark background.

verificationChecks: Are there multiple translucent arms visible?
Is the text in a white serif font at the top?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the dancer

mustAchieve: High contrast between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is perfectly aligned to top margins
recipe.reuseFormula: Central subject + stroboscopic motion + dark textured background + bokeh base + top-aligned serif typography.
